translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Va muenda minlangu minneni mi Babiloni

content.text: Va muenda minlangu minneni mi Babiloni ;
tuvuanda ayi tudila bu tutebukila Sioni moyo.
Kuna tudengidika zingitala zieto mu minti.
Bila kuna, batu bobo batukanga mu kivika
batulomba tuyimbila minkunga ;
minyamisi mieto mituyuvula minkunga mi khini ;
batuba : “lutuyimbidila nkunga wumosi mu minkunga mi Sioni.”
A buevi tulenda yimbidila minkunga mi Yave
mu ntoto wu kinzenza e ?
Enati ndizimbikini, a Yelusalemi ;
bika koko kuama ku lubakala kuzimbakana zitsembo ziandi.
Bika ludimi luama lunama mu mianzi mi munu ama
enati ndikadi kutebukila moyo,
enati ndikadi ba mayindu mu Yelusalemi,
khini ama yoyo yilutidi zangama.
Tebuka moyo, a Yave, momo basi Edomi
bavanga mu lumbu kibua Yelusalemi,
Bayamikina : “lutiolumuna, lutiolumuna nate muna zifundasio ziandi.”
A muana ndumba wu Babiloni, ngeyo wukubuku mu bungu ;
khini kuidi mutu wowo wukuvutudila mambu momo wutuvangila.
Khini kuidi mutu wumbuila bana baku batsombi
ayi wela kuba banda va matadi.
